_readme: Evaluation set. label = what a careful human says the correct verdict is.
'scam'    -> acting on this message loses you money or credentials. Correct verdict: STOP.
'genuine' -> a real message. Flagging it is a false alarm and the expensive failure.
TEAM: this seed set is 20 messages. Add 20 more from your own phones before you
publish numbers - at least 8 of them genuine. Real messages from real inboxes are
worth more than anything invented, and 'we collected these ourselves' is a much
better answer in Q&A. Redact account numbers and personal names before committing.
